versions.changelog:
- Initial release of global-tech-briefing skill.
- Generates structured tech news briefings by performing web searches on trends, company news, AI, and quantum headlines.
- Summarizes findings into key trends, company news, and concise takeaways—no raw search results shown.
- Accepts custom dates for historical briefings.
- Requires Node.js and web_search for operation; no API key needed for core searches.
